newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent, NYMEX extend bearish drift in Asia.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent, NYMEX extend bearish drift in Asia.

text.p: Crude futures in Asia maintained a downward drift on Wednesday, with NYMEX pushing below New York's intraday low.
NYMEX March crude on ACCESS was last traded at $24.14 per barrel, down eight cents from New York and below New York's intraday low of $24.15.
The NYMEX contract had traded as low as $24.12 earlier on ACCESS Wednesday.
The Brent contract adopted a similar tone on SIMEX, with just five lots changing hands at $22.35, down one cent from London.
London slipped 22 cents and closed just above an intraday low of $22.32 after feeling the weight of New York sales into the NYMEX expiry of the February contract.
Brokers said Brent was looking to hold above a key support level of $22.00, the intraday low on a downward spike in December and, at the time, a three-month low.
However, one chartist was looking for support at $22.17, based on an upward trend line off the March contract's August 27 intraday low of $18.20.
